data.name: Falimah
data.gender_notes: Falimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-l-m' which means to free or liberate. This name signifies the emancipation of one's soul from the shackles of material desires and worldly attachments. The name Falimah carries the meaning “Liberated, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Falimah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual freedom and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Falimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberated, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Falimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
